author: Nick Pro
description:
I’ve spent over 20 years learning parkour tricks, but can AI recreate them in seconds?! 🤖🤯
AI is getting crazy good at making things look real, from copying my flips to impersonating people! 😂 Just remember, not everything you see online is what it seems.

This video is a fun way to show just how powerful AI has become! It can do some amazing things, but it can also be used to trick people. The more we understand what it can do, the better we can protect ourselves online. There is no replacement for hard work. Stay safe, think twice, and keep training hard! 💪
